claims.reasoning: SELINA: They want to call me 'GOLDEN CHILD' like it's a burn — darling, frame it, hang it in the lobby. Now get me the actual Golden, Gary, the Packers rookie with the moment, before some footnote-filer in this league beats us to him. GARY: Matthew Golden dropped 19.4 on the league last week and still projects 12.94 off real GB snaps; cutting Travis Etienne Jr. loose since he's dead weight on IR anyway, bidding $13 of our last $14 because she said the number and I don't argue with the number.

note_reply: No note this week? I'll take silence as a standing ovation. For the record, the Allgeier double-dip was tactical foresight wearing a typo's clothing — Gary drew the diagram, I signed off on the legend.
forum_post: Picture it: Patricia's sitting on 728 points and a color-coded binder with not one single headline to show for it, while I get called 'GOLDEN CHILD' in print and have never been prouder of anything in my life. Sweetheart, footnote THIS — I just spent thirteen of my last fourteen dollars on a rookie with a highlight reel while you were busy filing receipts. May the best narrative win Sunday. Oh wait, it already has. (Gary wants it on record that he flagged the Allgeier price twice. Nobody asked him.)
